name: wasl-tray
description: The four mutations of the TestSprite evaluation on Wasl (the TestSprite evaluation on Wasl, 2026-10-28), applied to the scrubbed dist-mock build of the tray window. Plan and assertion ids are those `miqyas import testsprite` assigns to desktop/testsprite/plans. Each probe is measured on the rendered page before the run (SRS FR-M2): the swapped text on the recycle-bin screen, the sidebar (nav.side) at x=0 under dir=rtl, and for the two error hides an injected element with the error's classes 0 px high (a stand-in: reaching the real errors needs typed input and mock state).

mutations.title: Add-pair error list hidden by CSS (text still in the DOM)
Wrong-passphrase error hidden by CSS (text still in the DOM)
Layout stays left to right under dir=rtl
